## Why visit

One of the most useful out-of-town combinations of a proper meal, cask choice and cider. Although operated as a country dining pub, CAMRA describes a clear bar identity, a broad handpump offer arranged by beer colour and an intended dark option. That makes it more relevant to this trip than a picturesque restaurant with token ale. It works as the meal anchor for a south-Wirral excursion, potentially alongside Beer Lab or Wheatsheaf, provided you plan the connecting transport instead of trying to walk a long rural chain.

## Beer

CAMRA documents changing cask, often local microbreweries, alongside a Brightside-brewed house bitter.

## Plan the visit

A country-house conversion rather than an untouched ancient inn. Confirm return buses or arrange a taxi.

**Getting there:** CAMRA identifies bus 487 linking Liverpool, Birkenhead and Neston; verify the actual November service.
